shortDescription: The UK private sector is booming and households are holding up despite an energy shock and more than £80 billion ($106 billion) in tax increases since Labour took power in 2024, according to Bloomberg. Firms are driving the growth spurt, with the government claiming little credit.

title: UK Firms Fuel Growth Spurt With Little Government Help
